claim_boundary: This report measures evidence availability and demo-field completeness. It does not validate scientific accuracy, spatial representativeness or comparability, and it never promotes demo metrics to full-source claims.

findings.detail: No source currently has a uniform full-population numerator/denominator for every V4 field.
findings.next_action: Run adapters over verified full caches and emit per-field non-null, valid and missing-reason counts.

findings.detail: These executable sources have no checked-in candidate full-population audit.
findings.next_action: Add immutable full-source audits without substituting demo rows.

population_definitions.demo_fixture: Deterministic selected rows for engineering tests; never a full-population denominator.
population_definitions.full_population: Counts explicitly observed in a checked-in candidate audit over a verified source snapshot.
population_definitions.registered_contract: Expected counts in source_manifest.json; not treated as observations by this profile.
